description: SWG StringId preset (D-09 / Pitfall 2): two NUL-terminated C-strings = table then text (variable length). StringId is logically a table:text pair, but its IFF serialization is consumer-specific - this is the MOST COMMON on-wire form and the preset MOST LIKELY to need a per-chunk override (e.g. crc+string variants). A chunk that won't round-trip with this preset is a one-click preset edit, not an engine change (D-09 presets-are-editable-data). Pure JSON sugar over the kernel (D-08).
